key_insight: Coherent finite-resolution prices or predictions provide a constructive foundation for stochastic processes, with continuum limits derived from lattice approximations and controlled estimates.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects financial valuation and machine-learning prediction through an adjoint recursion while providing explicit convergence control for stochastic numerical methods.
method: Start with de Finetti’s previsions and impose coherence to obtain conditional expectations.
Compute measure changes on lattices using Farkas’ lemma, with uniqueness under completeness.
Control continuum limits through renormalisation and sharp convergence rates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 67 Python scripts that regenerate every numerical table and Lean 4 verification of much of the finite-dimensional core.
watch_item: Continuum guarantees depend on regularity and well-behaved reweighting; the abstract does not report machine-learning benchmark results.
paper_title: Constructive Probability, Foundations and Numerical Analysis for mathematical finance and machine learning
